LOCAL SOURCE EXCERPT, read from filesystem; line numbers preserved.
65: Every agent report uses CASE, CRITERIA STATUS, CONFLICTS, BLOCKERS, NEXT MOVE.
66: Ask one question at a time and show no approval odds. Criteria have three states:
67: `met`, `gap` (documented shortfall to argue), and `void` (missing documentation
68: to obtain). A filed source document can change a criterion. A surgeon's answer
69: is an attributed statement, never manufactured chart evidence.
70: 
71: The app owns the Policy, Governing section, Pathway, and Operative plan gate
72: controls, signing, packet submission, and recorded call outcome. Agent-generated
73: surfaces cannot render or invoke these as independent authority. In production,
74: enforce clinical authority at gateway policy, application capability, and
75: persistence boundaries independently. Neither administrators nor agents acting
76: for surgeons acquire the surgeon's authority by association.
77: 
78: Generated assertions carry source document, page, and date. Unsupported claims
79: are excluded and shown as such (the prototype uses “Not asserted in this
80: letter”). Source citations navigate to the applicable document. Keep PHI within
81: the inherited practice boundary and permitted inference policy; no real patient
82: data enters fixtures, logs, or commits.
